scripts.backend: cd backend && node ./scripts/encore-sync-if-needed.cjs && node ./scripts/migrate.cjs && encore run --listen=127.0.0.1:4477
scripts.dev: npm run setup && npx concurrently -n CORE,BACK,FRONT -c yellow,blue,cyan "npm:core" "npm:backend" "npm:frontend"
scripts.prod: node infra/scripts/version-manager.mjs && cd infra && powershell ./publish.ps1 && cd .. && npm run exe
scripts.generate: docker exec smartsafe-backend-encore encore gen client --output=client.gen.ts && move backend\client.gen.ts frontend\lib\client.ts
scripts.migrate: docker exec smartsafe-backend-encore npm run migrate
